sentences.en: We must pay a toll to drive on this road.
sentences.zh: 我们必须支付通行费才能走这条路。

sentences.en: When was the last time you used a toll road?
sentences.zh: 你上次使用收费公路是什么时候？

sentences.en: The missile attack took a heavy toll of lives.
sentences.zh: 导弹袭击造成了大量人员伤亡。

phrases.zh: 沉重的代价（通常指生命损失）

senses.zh: 通行费；代价；钟声；伤亡人数
